en.name: Cream sauce mix (with milk solids)
en.summary: This is the dry packet kind of cream sauce — a powdered mix containing milk solids that you make up with liquid. Unopened in the cupboard it keeps about 6–12 months from purchase. The milk solids are what limit it: the fat in them goes stale long before the starch does.
en.pantry: An unopened packet keeps about 6–12 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard. Dry is the operative word — milk powder draws moisture out of the air and clumps, and a clumped mix will not dissolve smoothly. Keep packets away from the hob, off the top of the fridge, and out of a cupboard that gets steam from the kettle. Once a packet is opened, decant the rest into an airtight jar rather than folding the paper over.
en.fridge: The dry mix does not need refrigeration and the fridge is in fact a poor place for it, because moving a packet in and out invites condensation into the powder. The made-up sauce is another matter entirely: once you have mixed it with milk or water and heated it, it is a perishable dairy sauce that must be cooled quickly and refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and treated as a leftover rather than as a shelf product.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for the dry mix, and freezing a powder achieves nothing except risking condensation in the packet. As for the finished sauce, cream and milk-based sauces are poor freezer candidates in general: they separate and go grainy on thawing, and whisking them back together only partly works. Make up the amount you are going to serve.
spoilage: Hard clumps or a caked block that will not break up
A stale, cardboard or crayon-like smell from the fat in the milk solids
Any sign of insects or webbing in the packet
Colour gone yellow or grey rather than creamy white
tips: Decant opened packets into an airtight jar with the date and the mixing instructions cut from the packet.
Store away from steam and heat; damp is what ends a dry mix.
Rotate stock so the oldest packet is at the front.
Make up only the amount you will serve — the prepared sauce is a perishable leftover.

faq.q: How long does dry cream sauce mix last?
faq.a: About 6–12 months from purchase, unopened in a cool dry cupboard.

faq.q: Does cream sauce mix need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No, and it is better not to — moving it in and out of the fridge invites condensation into the powder. The prepared sauce does need refrigeration.

faq.q: Can you freeze a made-up cream sauce?
faq.a: It is a poor candidate. Milk-based sauces separate and go grainy on thawing. Make up what you will serve instead.

faq.q: Why has my sauce mix gone lumpy in the packet?
faq.a: It has picked up moisture from the air. Store it airtight and away from steam; a caked mix will not dissolve properly.

zh.name: 奶油白醬粉
zh.summary: 這裡指的是乾燥粉包型的奶油白醬——含奶粉固形物、加液體調開使用的調味粉。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 6～12 個月。真正限制它的是奶固形物：裡面的乳脂會比澱粉更早走味。
zh.pantry: 未開封的粉包放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 6～12 個月。關鍵字是「乾燥」——奶粉會從空氣中吸水結塊，結塊後就調不開了。請遠離爐火，不要放在冰箱上方，也不要放在會被熱水壺蒸氣熏到的櫃子裡。粉包一旦開封，就把剩下的倒進密封罐，不要只把袋口折起來。
zh.fridge: 乾粉不需要冷藏，事實上冰箱對它很不友善，因為反覆進出會讓冷凝水跑進粉裡。調好的醬則完全是另一回事：一旦加牛奶或水調開並加熱，它就是易腐的乳製醬汁，必須快速放涼、放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並當成剩菜處理，而不是常溫商品。
zh.freezer: 乾粉沒有冷凍期限，冷凍粉末也沒有任何好處，只會讓包裝內產生冷凝水。至於調好的醬，奶油和牛奶基底的醬汁本來就不適合冷凍：解凍後會分離、變粗，攪回去也只能補救一部分。請調你這一餐吃得完的量。
spoilage: 出現硬塊，或整包結成一塊敲不散
聞起來有陳味、紙板味或蠟筆味，那是乳脂走味
顏色從奶白轉黃或發灰
tips: 開封後倒進密封罐，並把日期和包裝上的沖調說明一起貼上。
遠離蒸氣和熱源；毀掉乾粉的是潮濕。
先進先出，最舊的放最前面。
只調這一餐要用的量——調好的醬就是易腐的剩菜。

faq.a: 未開封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 6～12 個月。
不用，而且最好不要——進出冰箱會讓冷凝水跑進粉裡。調好的醬才需要冷藏。

faq.q: 調好的白醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 不太適合。牛奶基底的醬汁解凍後會分離變粗。建議只調吃得完的量。
它從空氣中吸了水。請密封存放、遠離蒸氣；結塊的粉調不開。
